name: Legion Saga II
storyline: A man named Nastra runs away intro the country of Krisdea from the country of Veramonde for murdering another man. He is followed by a dark elf and his companion to capture Nastra's head, who has a bounty placed on him. He meets a Kobold named Fuba who kills the dark elf's companion. Nastra eventually kills the Dark Elf. Nastra eventually joins a rebellion and runs a customizable castle.
summary: Legion Saga II is a game created by Kamau. It is the sequel to the original Legion Saga.
